question: For whose desired accomplishment is the rite of the bird-king intended?
premises: The bird-king is the focus of the rite.
All men are included as beneficiaries.
The purpose is accomplishment of what is desired.
inference: The rite of the bird-king is intended for the desired accomplishment of all people.
plain_english: For the desired accomplishment of all people, this rite of the king of birds is intended.
